# C3 `cluster_internal` Service-host cases. One file, two readers:
# `cluster_internal_requires_service_host` in src/gateway/server/cleartext_tests.rs
# (the gateway's check) and scripts/dev/helm-chart-smoke.sh (the chart's render
# check), so the two cannot drift apart.
#
# Columns: verdict public_url cluster_domain ("-" means the default,
# cluster.local). The chart renders these as release fullname "gw" in namespace
# "ns", so every accepted row names gw.ns.svc.
accept http://gw.ns.svc.cluster.local:39400 -
accept http://gw.ns.svc:39400 -
accept http://gw.ns.svc.corp.example:39400 corp.example
reject https://mcp.example.com -
reject https://api.svc.example.com -
reject http://gw.svc.cluster.local -
reject http://gw.ns.svc.cluster.local:39400 corp.example
